title: Publication Status Contract
description: X0-consumable typed publication surface state. Distinguishes all transition phases with explicit field coverage so the desktop frontend can render Publish Preview and deployment status without parsing private ledgers.

publication_operation_id.description: Identifies the publication operation this contract describes.

transition_phase.description: Current transition phase of the publication lifecycle.

target_repository_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the target repository identity (owner/repo).

authorization_required.description: Whether step-up authorization is required before mutation.

authorization_status.description: Current authorization state for this publication operation.

pages_configured.description: Whether GitHub Pages has been configured for this repo.

content_published.description: Whether content has been pushed to the target branch.

content_publication_mode.description: How content was published to the target branch.

published_commit_sha.description: SHA of the published commit on the target branch.

build_status.description: Pages build status (queued, building, built, errored, or empty).

build_commit_sha.description: Commit SHA that Pages is building from.

build_commit_matches_published.description: Whether the Pages build commit matches the published content commit.

published_verified.description: Whether the publication has been remotely verified.

refusal_code.description: Structured refusal code if the publication was refused.

status_message.description: Human-readable status message for the current phase.

available_actions.description: Actions the user can take from the current phase.

projection_digest.description: SHA256 digest of this projection itself.

terminal_receipt_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the terminal evidence receipt.

evidence_linkage.description: Content-light evidence linkage for X0 auditability.

terminal_receipt_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the terminal evidence receipt.

evidence_ledger_path.description: Relative path to the evidence ledger file. Content-light: path only, no contents.

projection_digest.description: SHA256 digest of this projection itself.
